ma.getsmallappinfo(Object object)

Query the basic information of the Mini Program (minimum version: 23.12.0)

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
success Function No Callback function for a successful API call.
fail Function No Callback function for a failed API call.
complete Function No Callback function used when an API call is complete. (This callback function is used whether the API call succeeds or fails.)

object.success callback function

parameter

Object res

Attribute Type Mandatory or Not Description
appId String Yes Mini Program id
name String Yes Mini Program name
appIcon String Yes Mini Program icon

Sample Code

ma.getsmallappinfo({
  success(res) {
    console.log(res.appId);
    console.log(res.name);
    console.log(res.appIcon);
  }
});
